# awscc_timestream_influx_db_backup (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::Timestream::InfluxDBBackup



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `allocated_storage` (Number) The allocated storage of the resource at the time of backup, in GiB.
- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the backup.
- `cluster_configuration` (Attributes) The cluster configuration of the resource at the time of backup. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cluster_configuration))
- `created_at` (String) The time when the backup was created.
- `db_instance_type` (String) The DB instance type of the resource at the time of backup.
- `db_parameter_group_id` (String) The identifier of the DB parameter group associated with the backup.
- `db_resource_id` (String) The id of the DB instance or DB cluster to back up.
- `db_storage_type` (String) The storage type of the resource at the time of backup.
- `deployment_type` (String) The deployment type of the resource that the backup was created from.
- `engine_type` (String) The engine type of the resource that the backup was created from.
- `expires_after` (String) The date after which the backup will be automatically deleted, as a calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
- `failover_mode` (String) The failover mode of the resource at the time of backup.
- `influx_auth_parameters_secret_arn` (String) The ARN of the Secrets Manager secret containing the InfluxDB auth parameters.
- `influx_db_backup_id` (String) Service-generated unique identifier of the backup.
- `kms_key_id` (String) The Amazon Web Services KMS key ARN used for encryption of the resource at the time of backup.
- `log_delivery_configuration` (Attributes) The log delivery configuration of the resource at the time of backup. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--log_delivery_configuration))
- `maintenance_schedule` (Attributes) The maintenance schedule of the resource at the time of backup. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--maintenance_schedule))
- `name` (String) The name of the backup. Must be unique within the account and region.
- `network_type` (String) The network type of the resource at the time of backup.
- `port` (Number) The port number of the resource at the time of backup.
- `publicly_accessible` (Boolean) Indicates whether the resource was publicly accessible at the time of backup.
- `retention_days` (Number) The number of days to retain the backup. Valid values are 1 to 3650.
- `status` (String) The current status of the backup.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) A list of key-value pairs to associate with the backup. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `type` (String) The type of backup. Backups created through this resource type are always ON_DEMAND.
- `vpc_security_group_ids` (List of String) The VPC security group IDs associated with the resource at the time of backup.
- `vpc_subnet_ids` (List of String) The VPC subnet IDs associated with the resource at the time of backup.

Read-Only:

- `dedicated_compactor` (Boolean) Indicates if the compactor instance is a standalone instance or not.
- `ingest_query_instances` (Number) The number of ingest and query instances in the cluster.
- `query_only_instances` (Number) The number of query-only instances in the cluster.

Read-Only:

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether log delivery to the S3 bucket is enabled.

- `timezone` (String) The IANA timezone identifier for the maintenance window.
